meta.name: full-output-enforcement
meta.description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制生成完整代码，禁止占位符截断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到LLM输出被截断或出现占位符的问题
copy.tagline_en: Force complete code generation, ban placeholder truncation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face LLM output truncation or placeholder issues

howto.what: Claude 不再把输出截断：你要整份文件就给整份文件、要 5 个组件就给 5 个，并禁止 `// ...`、`// TODO` 这类占位写法。输出接近长度上限时，它会停在一个完整断点并显示进度，等你说「continue」再从那里接着写。
howto.when: 当你要求「完整、无删减」的输出时触发，例如要整份文件、全部组件等，任何需要一次给全的任务都走这套规则。

say.text: 把这个文件完整写出来，不要省略任何部分
say.note: 输出完整内容，不出现占位符。

say.text: 给我全部 5 个组件的完整代码，一个都别少
say.note: 数量先被锁定，逐个写完。
从上次中断的断点接着写，不重复前面内容。

howto.what_en: Claude stops truncating: it delivers every requested file, component and section in full, and never emits placeholders like `// ...` or `// TODO`. Near the token limit it pauses at a clean breakpoint and resumes on "continue".
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever the task calls for exhaustive, unabridged output — a whole file, every component, etc.

say_en.text: Write the whole file out — don't leave any part out
say_en.note: Output comes back complete, with no placeholders.

say_en.text: Give me the full code for all 5 components, none skipped
say_en.note: The count is locked and each one is finished.
Resumes at the exact breakpoint, no recap.
